headline: More Mexicans, fewer homes and many obstacles to building them
summary: Infonavit data show affordable and popular housing units built in January to July fell to about 20,000 in 2025 from 140,100 in the same months of 2015, an 85.7% drop.
why: Housing construction is a major economic driver, and Infonavit is Mexico's state housing fund that finances many worker home purchases.
original_headline: Más mexicanos, menos viviendas y muchos obstáculos para construirlas
